title: Solo dev working on an MMORPG concept – Would love your feedback!
author: Simple_Day_1311
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share a playable concept/demo I've been working on entirely by myself: **Realm of Kingdoms**.

I know how sensitive the topic of AI art is in the gaming community right now, so I want to be 100% transparent upfront: **this current prototype uses AI-generated assets purely as placeholders** to test the core vision and scale of an MMORPG concept. The actual full version currently in development will feature **fully hand-made art**.

As a solo developer, my main goal right now is to nail down the core gameplay loop, combat responsiveness, and progression systems before committing to the final art production pipeline.

I would genuinely appreciate any constructive feedback on how it feels to play. If you have a few minutes to check out the concept, it would help me immensely.

* **Playable Demo / Website:** [https://realm-of-kingdom.vercel.app/es](https://realm-of-kingdom.vercel.app/es)
* **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/z8VU8ZQmUQ](https://discord.gg/z8VU8ZQmUQ)

Thanks a lot for your time, support, and honest feedback!
